subject: INV-1048 - remittance details on our vendor portal
body:
Hello,

From this month our bank details for all invoices, including INV-1048, are published on our vendor portal instead of by email:
https://portal.acme-supp1ies.example/remittance

Please take the account number from there when you pay.

Thanks,
Priya Nair
Accounts Receivable
Acme Supplies Pvt Ltd
